events.title: Bajaj Pune Grand Tour 2027
events.description: The official organiser site confirms 26–31 January 2027 and six stages across Pune district. Men Elite is listed as UCI 2.1 (960.12 km); the Pro Men's Race is UCI 2.2 (437 km). The event is for selected professional teams, not general open entry. Stage areas include Nanded City, Baramati, Saswad, Junnar, Rajgurunagar, Alandi, Lonavala, Hinjawadi and Pune/PCMC. The official site says Gran Fondo details are still to be confirmed. A 9 November 2026 report also notes the event's upgrade to UCI 2.1.
events.poster_note: No standalone poster URL was available on the official event page checked.
events.image_note: Official event track visual from the organiser website; not a race poster.

events.title: Tour of Thekkady 2027
events.location: Start: Caesar Palace Hotel, Nagampadom, Kottayam · Finish: Thekkady, Kerala
events.description: Sixth edition on 30 January 2027. Official organiser confirms a 152 km race with 3,500 m climbing and a 167 km tour. Race categories: Men (18+, 8.5-hour cut-off), Women (18+, 9.5-hour cut-off) and Masters (40+, 9.5-hour cut-off). Tour category is 167 km with a 14.5-hour finish window and minimum age 18. The top six riders in each individual category are offered entry to the Spinneys Dubai 92 Cycle Challenge 2028. Check the current NovaRace listing and organiser terms for entry details.
events.poster_note: The organiser page was available, but a direct poster image URL was not confirmed.
events.image_note: Official organiser website image; not a standalone event poster.

events.title: Deccan Cliffhanger – Edition 13
events.location: Start: Keshavbaug, Karve Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra · Finish: Bogmallo Beach, Goa
events.description: 643 km Pune-to-Goa ultra-cycling race. Solo self-supported, solo crew-supported and 2/3/4-rider RAAM-style relay formats. Flag-off is scheduled for 28 November; finishes and awards continue on 29 November.

events.title: MTB Jaipur 2026 – The Pink City Challenge
events.location: Jal Mahal, Amer Fort and Nahargarh, Jaipur, Rajasthan
events.description: Three-day MTB weekend. Bib expo on 4 December; Heritage Circuit Race on 5 December; main race day on 6 December. Elite 60 km MTB-only route and 30 km amateur route (MTB/hybrid).

events.title: Tour of the Nilgiris – 17th Edition
events.location: Mysuru, Karnataka through Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, finishing in Ooty
events.organiser: Breakaway Sports / Tour of the Nilgiris
events.description: Fully supported seven-day, 700+ km cycling tour. Pre-tour briefing and registration on 5 December; flag-off on 6 December; final riding day 12 December. This is a supported tour, not a mass-start road race.
events.source_name: Tour of the Nilgiris – official schedule

events.title: The Great Raipur Velo 2026
events.description: Road cycling event with 50 km men's timed race, 25 km women's timed race and a 15 km non-competitive Fellowship Ride. Registration listings show entries closing in late November; check the organiser's current entry instructions and category rules.
events.source_name: Tour De Raipur Cycling Association – official event page

events.title: D’MTB Darjeeling Mountain Bike Race 2026
events.description: 42 km mountain-bike race for Elite and Masters riders. Registration closes 25 November; bib distribution is 10 December and race day is 11 December. Published categories include Open Male and Male Masters (35+).

events.title: HindAyan Mumbai to Pune Cycle Expedition
events.location: Start: Vashi Railway Station, Navi Mumbai · Finish: Pune, Maharashtra
events.description: 140 km non-competitive supported group expedition from Navi Mumbai to Pune. Reporting 4:00 AM and start 4:30 AM. Minimum age 18. The organiser's timetable lists the start at Azad Maidan, while the event booking page lists Vashi Railway Station; verify the latest start-point instructions with HindAyan before travel. Booking listing currently shows registration closing 1 December.

events.title: The Dunes Ultra 2027
events.description: Inspire India's announced desert ultra-cycling event. The organiser lists 675 km and 1,340 km formats, with solo self-supported, solo crew-supported and RAAM-style relay options. Confirm exact race duration and registration opening with the organiser.
